title: Extraction Candidate Record
description: Contract emitted by every parser/extractor (HTML, PDF, XLSX/CSV) and consumed by the normalisation/validation stage. One record per candidate fact. Mirrors source doc §11.5 verbatim, extended with required-field enforcement for FR-016/FR-017/FR-020.

id.description: Existing subject record_id. Extractor MUST NOT invent a new subject id; unresolved subjects are routed to Data Quality instead of guessed.

metric_id.description: Must resolve against the metric-definition registry; unresolved metric_id is a validation failure (unknown_metric_definition), not a silently-accepted free-text metric.

raw_value.description: Value exactly as it appeared in the source, before any normalisation.

source_locator.description: Page, table, row, heading, or CSS selector identifying exactly where this value was found.

verbatim_excerpt.description: Short supporting excerpt only — extractors must not copy full paragraphs/pages (copyright, and FR-016 only requires a short excerpt).

review_status.description: Extractors MUST always emit unreviewed — no extractor is permitted to self-approve (FR-017).
